newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GOLF-W.PROVINCE CLOSE TO WINNING INTER-PROVINCIAL.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-W.PROVINCE CLOSE TO WINNING INTER-PROVINCIAL.

text.p: Western Province are on the brink of reclaiming the inter-provincial golf title having recorded a third successive win by beating Natal at Clovelly Country Club on Wednesday.
They need only to win their final match against bottom of the log Border on Thursday to secure the title they last won three years ago.
With the wind gusting to near gale force the Western Province players demonstrated their familiarity with local conditions by claiming the foursomes, 3-1, against Natal.

They were made to struggle for the extra three and a half points they needed for victory which was only secured in the fifth singles match when Trevor Immelman, the youngest player in the tournament, defeated the oldest man in the field, Ivan Curlewis 47, one up.
In the other match Eastern Province recorded a comfortable 8-4 victory over Border but their remote chances of the title disappeared with Western Province's victory.
Western Province (2 pts) beat Natal (0 pts), 7 and a half to 4 and half. Foursomes: Western Province 3, Natal 1. Singles: Western Province 4 and a half, Natal 7 and a half.
Eastern Province (2pts) beat Border (0 pts) 8-4. Foursomes: Eastern Province 4, Border 0. Singles: Eastern Province 4, Border 4.
